summary.headline: Hyleg Directions and Casting Rays
summary.text: Instructions for directing years from the Hyleg and ascendant by degrees of ascension, judging survival or death from fortunate and evil aspects to the directed degree, the wood of life, Sun, and Moon. The text then explains the casting of rays between planets in the fourth and tenth places.
